lines.en: label beachfive12:
scene beachsleepyay1
{b}BUT THAT DOESN’T MATTER ANYMORE BECAUSE IT’S SUDDENLY TIME TO FUCKING PARTYYYYY!{/b}
lines.zh: {b}不过那些都不重要了，因为现在是他妈的开派对的时间！{/b}

lines.en: : Attention friends! If you are hearing me right now, it means you’ve been invited to the slumber party to end all slumber parties! Perhaps even somewhat literally!
lines.zh: : 各位朋友请注意！如果你现在听得到我的声音，说明你被邀请参加终结所有睡衣派对的睡衣派对！甚至可能字面意义上如此！

lines.en: : Thanks for having us! But you might want to tone it down a little because, at this rate, everyone down the hall might hear you as well and we’ll need to get more futons.
lines.zh: : 谢谢邀请！不过你最好小声点，照这个音量，走廊那头的人都会听见，我们就得再多准备蒲团了。

lines.en: : Nah. Whoever shows up next can have mine. You didn’t tell me there were going to be other people here- let alone a live predator.
lines.zh: : 不用。下一个来的人可以用我的。你又没告诉我这儿还有别人——更别说还有一头活的捕食者。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay2
: I think she’s talking about you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她说的是你，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yeah, she does that a lot.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她经常这样。

lines.en: : Yumi, be nice. It took an incredible amount of bravery for Sensei to even come here. The least you can do is wait until he wrongs you to start talking bad about him.
lines.zh: : Yumi，友善点。Sensei 能来这儿已经需要相当大的勇气了。你至少等他真的得罪了你，再来说他坏话吧。

lines.en: : He wronged me the second I walked through the door because I made the foolish decision to think I was free from wrapping my chest tonight.
lines.zh: : 我踏进门的那一刻他就得罪我了，因为我犯了个蠢——以为今晚不用缠胸。

lines.en: : And we’re all very thankful for that.
lines.zh: : 而我们所有人都对此感激不尽。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re kinda huge. And standing next to Sana just makes that even more apparent.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你还挺大的。站在 Sana 旁边就更明显了。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay3
: I’m at a...severe disadvantage because of...my height.
lines.zh: : 因为……身高问题，我处于……严重的劣势。

lines.en: : Tell that to Uta. She’s only an inch taller than you and she’s packing heat.
lines.zh: : 这话你去跟 Uta 说。她只比你高一英寸，照样火力十足。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay4
: But we’re not here to compare breast sizes!
lines.zh: : 不过我们不是来比胸围的！

lines.en: : Can we still do it later, though? Preferably with adult supervision so nothing gets out of hand?
lines.zh: : 那能待会儿再比吗？最好有成年人监督，免得场面失控？

lines.en: : Maybe! But not until we’ve gotten what we need to do out of the way first!
lines.zh: : 也许吧！不过得先把该办的事办完！

lines.en: : And the fuck is it that we {i}need{/i} to do? Noriko didn’t tell me there was a fuckin’ {i}objective{/i} to this bullshit- just that there was gonna be food.
lines.zh: : 我们到底「{i}需要{/i}」干什么？Noriko 可没告诉我这破事还有什么{i}目标{/i}——只说会有吃的。

lines.en: : In all fairness, {i}I{/i} don’t really know what the objective is either. I just heard “slumber party” and “Sensei” in the same sentence and signed both of us up.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，{i}我{/i}也真不知道目标是什么。我只是听到「睡衣派对」和「Sensei」出现在同一句话里，就替我们俩都报了名。

lines.en: : You’re not...going to make us study...are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会……是要我们学习……吧？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay5
: It’s less about studying and more about trying to figure out if any of you are capable of bearing knowledge that the world we live in is an infinitely looping-
lines.zh: : 与其说是学习，不如说是想看看你们有没有能力承受这样一个事实——我们生活的世界是一个无限循环的——

lines.en: : Yeah, whatever. When does the food get here?
lines.zh: : 行行行，随便吧。吃的多会儿到？

lines.en: : That we live in a world where-
lines.zh: : 我们生活在一个——

lines.en: : I’m kind of hungry too. Do you think UberEats delivers to the beach?
lines.zh: : 我也挺饿的。你觉得 UberEats 会送到海滩来吗？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay6
: This may be harder than I anticipated.
lines.zh: : 这可能比我想象的更难。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong, but wasn’t Nodoka supposed to come as well?
lines.zh: : 要是我记错了请纠正我，Nodoka 不是也应该来吗？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay7

: Fuckin’ good thing she didn’t. It’s bad enough havin’ to sleep in the same fuckin’ building as {i}that{/i} guy. If four-eyes was here, y’all would have to worry about figuring out how to clean blood off tatami.
lines.zh: : 她没来真是他妈的万幸。光是跟那个家伙睡在同一栋楼里就够糟的了。要是四眼妹也在这儿，你们就得操心怎么把血从榻榻米上擦掉了。

lines.en: : Water and vinegar. Wipe {i}with{/i} the weave, not against it.
lines.zh: : 水和醋。{i}顺着{/i}纹理擦，不要逆着。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay8
: Why do you know that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会知道这个？

lines.en: : Just in case!
lines.zh: : 以防万一嘛！

lines.en: : I wanted Nodoka to come, yeah. But I was looking for her all day and couldn’t find her.
lines.zh: : 我是想让 Nodoka 来的，没错。可我找了她一整天都没找到。

lines.en: : She only {i}just{/i} turned up a little while ago, but Futaba says she needs her rest or something and that it would be best to leave her alone. Which I guess is good for Yumi’s sake.
lines.zh: : 她前不久{i}才刚{/i}露面，不过 Futaba 说她需要休息什么的，最好别去打扰她。我想这对 Yumi 来说是好事。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about Nodoka. She was with me earlier and she knows...way more than you’d expect about what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 别担心 Nodoka。她之前跟我在一起，而她对眼下发生的事知道得……比你们预想的多得多。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay9
: Ah. So {i}that’s{/i} what I heard when I tried to drop by earlier.
lines.zh: : 啊。原来我之前想顺路过去时听到的，是那回事啊。

lines.en: : What do you mean she “knows more than we’d expect?” Were you actually able to talk to her about this?
lines.zh: : 你说她「知道得比预想的多」是什么意思？你真的跟她谈过这件事了？

lines.en: : Talk about {i}what?{/i} You ain’t said fuck-all about why you need a goddamn slumber party just to tell us shit. And why {i}us{/i} in the first place? I don’t even like you people.
lines.zh: : 谈{i}什么{/i}？你他妈一个字都没说，为什么非得开个该死的睡衣派对才能告诉我们这些破事。还有为什么是{i}我们{/i}？我根本就不喜欢你们这群人。

lines.en: : False. You like me.
lines.zh: : 错。你喜欢我。

lines.en: : No, I {i}tolerate{/i} you. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 不，我是对你「{i}容忍{/i}」。这不一样。

lines.en: scene black
: I already tried to tell you! But successfully doing that is going to take some amount of work, so...
lines.zh: : 我刚才就试着告诉你们了！可要真讲明白得花点功夫，所以……

lines.en: : For now, why doesn’t everybody make themselves comfortable so I can reconvene with Sensei and Makoto and figure out how we’re going to tackle this! Slumber party team, disperse!
lines.zh: : 现在，大家先随意舒服一下，我好跟 Sensei 和 Makoto 碰个头，商量该怎么处理！睡衣派对小队，散开！

lines.en: : Just make sure to only disperse throughout the room since I don’t want to go track any of you down again. Looking at you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 但只能在房间里散开，我可不想再去找你们回来。说的就是你，Yumi。

lines.en: : Yeah, fuckin’ everybody is lookin’ at me tonight.
lines.zh: : 是啊，今晚他妈的所有人都在看我。

lines.en: : And this is precisely why you should ditch the sarashi for good and {i}accept{/i} that you are gifted.
lines.zh: : 所以你才该彻底扔掉那条裹胸布，{i}接受{/i}你天赋异禀这个事实。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay10
: {i}You perverted fuckin’...where’s the goddamn food?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这变态的……该死的吃的多会儿到？！{/i}

lines.en: : So...what’s going on with Nodoka? Were you actually able to get through to her earlier?
lines.zh: : 那么……Nodoka 是怎么回事？你之前真的跟她说明白了吗？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay11
: Yeah, what? You didn’t mention anything about handling her on your own during our meeting. What does she know?
lines.zh: : 对啊，怎么回事？我们开会的时候你可没提过要独自搞定她。她都知道些什么？

lines.en: : She managed to figure out that we’re caught in a time loop.
lines.zh: : 她自己琢磨出来了——我们被困在时间循环里。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay12
: What?! How?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！怎么做到的？！

lines.en: : What do you mean “how?” This is Nodoka we’re talking about. If you locked her in a padded room by herself and told her to come up with a cure for cancer, she’d be done in a week.
lines.zh: : 「怎么做到的」是什么意思？我们说的是 Nodoka 啊。你要是把她一个人锁进软垫房，让她想出治愈癌症的方法，她一周就能搞定。

lines.en: : Someone should definitely lock her in a padded room then. For the greater good.
lines.zh: : 那真该有人把她锁进软垫房。为了更大的善。

lines.en: : To be honest, I’m not even fully convinced she’s human. And that’s even more true now that she’s apparently managed to piece together all of the weird time-related stuff happening to us.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我甚至不太确信她是人类。而既然她居然把所有发生在我们身上的怪异时间现象拼到了一起，这点就更让人怀疑了。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay13
: It’s not {i}all{/i} of it.
lines.zh: : 也不是{i}全部{/i}。

lines.en: : She said a lot of stuff I didn’t understand either, but...for the most part, it seems that she understands that {i}something{/i} is wrong. And that’s more than anyone else has been able to do so far.
lines.zh: : 她也说了很多我没听懂的东西，但……大体上，她似乎明白有{i}什么{/i}地方不对劲。而这已经比迄今任何人能做到的都多了。

lines.en: : So if she’s not here, it’s fine. And at this rate, trying to tell her {i}anything{/i} would probably cause her to freak out even more than she already was earlier. That’s another thing, though...
lines.zh: : 所以她不在这儿也没关系。而且照这个情况，试图告诉她{i}任何{/i}事，大概只会让她比之前更崩溃。不过还有一件事……

lines.en: : Even if she {i}does{/i} know something...figuring out more about it seems nigh impossible since she’s still dealing with that same sort of thing everyone else does when we try to tell them.
lines.zh: : 就算她{i}确实{/i}知道些什么……想再深挖下去似乎几乎不可能，因为我们想告诉别人时，她也会遇到其他人都会遇到的那种状况。

lines.en: : Just, instead of immediately changing the subject, she has to fight away some sort of headache or something.
lines.zh: : 只不过，别人是立刻转移话题，而她得先忍过某种头痛之类的东西。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay14

: But it’s still the same sort of countermeasure...which calls into question whether or not she’s unable to follow her train of thought to its last stop because she simply isn’t {i}meant{/i} to know or if-
lines.zh: : 可这终究是同一种反制机制……这就引人怀疑了：她没法顺着思路走到最后一步，究竟是因为她本就{i}不该{/i}知道，还是——

lines.en: : If there’s some kind of supernatural entity or force physically {i}preventing{/i} her from knowing!
lines.zh: : 还是有某种超自然存在或力量在物理上{i}阻止{/i}她知道！

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay15
: Sure. If you actually believe in that sort of nonsense.
lines.zh: : 行吧。如果你真信那种鬼话的话。

lines.en: : How can you {i}not?{/i} We’re effectively time travelers. The existence of the supernatural would be like a four on the weird scale at this point.
lines.zh: : 你怎么能{i}不{/i}信？我们实际上就是时间旅行者。超自然的存在在诡异程度上大概只能算四级。

lines.en: : Plus, you remember Big Boi, don't you?
lines.zh: : 再说，你还记得 Big Boi 吧？

lines.en: : I try not to.
lines.zh: : 我尽量不去想。

lines.en: : So you {i}do{/i} remember. What was he if not supernatural?
lines.zh: : 那你{i}确实{/i}记得。那东西不是超自然还能是什么？

lines.en: : ...Big Boi?
lines.zh: : ……Big Boi？

lines.en: : Some...hallucination, I assume. But if you'd give {i}that{/i} thing a four, what would a ten be?
lines.zh: : 我猜是某种……幻觉。不过如果{i}那{/i}东西你给四分，十分会是什么？

lines.en: : A world where Sensei is gay.
lines.zh: : 一个 Sensei 是同性恋的世界。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay16
: Okay. Fair.
lines.zh: : 好吧。有道理。

lines.en: : Really? {i}That{/i} would be the most unbelievable thing that could possibly happen?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？{i}那{/i}会是可能发生的最难以置信的事？

lines.en: : Yeah. You’ve been in probably like a million, trillion different timelines and I don’t think you’ve slept with a boy in any of them.
lines.zh: : 对。你大概经历过一百万、万亿条不同的时间线，而我不觉得你在任何一条里跟男生睡过。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay17
: Yeah, because I’m still {i}me{/i} in all of them. And men are in short supply around here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，因为在每一条里我都还是{i}我{/i}。而且这附近男性本来就稀缺。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Sensei. I prefer only having to compete against one sex for your love.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sensei。我更愿意只跟一个性别争夺你的爱。

lines.en: : I’m not worrying, I’m-
lines.zh: : 我不是在担心，我是——

lines.en: : Listen, as {i}fun{/i} as it would be for the three of us to talk about the possibility of Sensei one day having sex with a man, we have bigger things on our plate right now.
lines.zh: : 听着，虽然我们仨讨论 Sensei 哪天跟男人上床的可能性很{i}有趣{/i}，但我们眼下还有更要紧的事。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay18
: That wouldn’t be {i}fun{/i} at all...
lines.zh: : 那一点也不{i}有趣{/i}……

lines.en: : Makoto’s right. So, getting back on track, there are two ways I figure we can handle this.
lines.zh: : Makoto 说得对。那么回到正题，我觉得我们有两种处理方式。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay19
: Option one — we treat this like a normal slumber party, but sort of...{i}pepper in{/i} comments throughout the night that hopefully plant some kind of seed in the other girls’ minds.
lines.zh: : 方案一——我们把它当成普通的睡衣派对，只是……在整晚的聊天里{i}夹带{/i}一些话，希望能在其他女孩心里种下点什么。

lines.en: : Nodoka’s special, sure. But if she was able to figure things out on her own, maybe that’s how it {i}has{/i} to be in order to work? Maybe we just can’t {i}literally{/i} tell them?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 确实特别。但如果她能靠自己想明白，也许这本来{i}就得{/i}是那样才可行？也许我们就是不能{i}直截了当地{/i}告诉她们？

lines.en: : So the idea would just be to...provide a bunch of hints? Point out the fallacies and contradictions in this current timeline and hope they can somewhat comprehend all of that?
lines.zh: : 所以思路就是……给出一堆暗示？指出当前时间线里的谬误与矛盾，指望她们多少能理解一点？

lines.en: : Pretty much, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多，对。

lines.en: : Well, what’s the second option? Because you clearly have more faith in our classmates’ intellect than I do.
lines.zh: : 那方案二呢？显然你对我们同学的智力比我更有信心。

lines.en: : The second option would be to do what we’ve done in the past in just {i}literally{/i} attempting to explain things. The issue there is that this slumber party is a lot different from the last.
lines.zh: : 方案二就是沿用我们以前的做法，直接{i}字面意义上地{/i}解释。问题在于，这次的睡衣派对和上次大不一样。

lines.en: : Last time, we had a couple girls who already stopped interrupting us any time we tried to talk to them. And, while we still don’t know {i}why,{/i} that method did have its pros and cons.
lines.zh: : 上次，有几个女孩已经不再在我们试图开口时打断我们了。虽然我们至今不明白{i}为什么{/i}，但那套方法确实有利有弊。

lines.en: : The key “pro” here would be getting additional insight or fresh perspectives on what all of this could possibly mean, ultimately pointing us in a new or better direction.
lines.zh: : 这里的关键「利」在于，能获得关于这一切究竟意味着什么的额外洞见或新鲜视角，最终把我们指向一个新的、更好的方向。

lines.en: : And a key “con” would be?
lines.zh: : 那关键的「弊」是什么？

lines.en: : The world explodes again.
lines.zh: : 世界再次爆炸。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay20
: Hmm...that is a pretty big con.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那确实是个相当大的弊。

lines.en: : What do you think, Sensei? Pepper in some hints? Or go all-in and try to break through with brute force?
lines.zh: : 你怎么看，Sensei？夹带暗示？还是孤注一掷，用蛮力突破？

lines.en: : I guess that depends on if we want to try to provoke another reset since that’s what happened last time we did this. But if none of us can sense one coming...
lines.zh: : 我想这取决于我们想不想再触发一次重置，毕竟上次我们这么做的结果就是那样。但如果我们谁都感觉不到它要来……

lines.en: : Maybe we could try a mixture of both? Pepper in hints and then...try to {i}make{/i} them hop on that train of thought so those hints don’t just get thrown out?
lines.zh: : 也许两种可以混着来？先夹带暗示，然后……试着把她们{i}推{/i}上那条思路，好让那些暗示不至于被直接扔掉？

lines.en: : That’s sort of what I did with Yumi and Tsuneyo last time. Just...tried to remind them of stuff and...went from there.
lines.zh: : 上次我对 Yumi 和 Tsuneyo 差不多就是这么做的。就是……试着提醒她们一些事，然后……顺其自然。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay21
: In that case, why don’t we split up? Doing such a thing in a group setting would only make it harder to stick to one specific subject as it risks someone else attempting to change it.
lines.zh: : 那样的话，我们为什么不分开行动？在这种集体场合里做这种事，只会更难把话题固定在某一件事上，因为随时可能有人试图岔开。

lines.en: : Sensei, you can handle Yumi again since you’ve had success with her in the past.
lines.zh: : Sensei，Yumi 还是交给你，你以前和她谈成过。

lines.en: : I think that’s a good idea. Which means I should try talking to Sana since the two of us are already close.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这主意不错。那我就去试着跟 Sana 谈，毕竟我们俩本来就亲近。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay22
: That leaves me with Noriko, then. Which seems like the slimmest connection out of our three pairs...but I’ll see what I can do regardless.
lines.zh: : 那就剩下我跟 Noriko 了。三对组合里我们这对的交情看起来最浅……不过不管怎样我还是尽力试试。

lines.en: : Can I have a minute or two to come up with a plan? It’d be strange if I were to just...approach her, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 能给我一两分钟想个计划吗？要是我就这么……直接凑过去，会显得很奇怪吧？

lines.en: : Not really. Noriko’s super approachable — even for someone with a low charisma stat like you.
lines.zh: : 不会。Noriko 特别好接近——就连你这种魅力值低的人都没问题。

lines.en: : I could just leave altogether if that’s what you’d prefer? It’s not as if I have anything to gain from participating in this.
lines.zh: : 你要是更愿意，我可以干脆走人？反正参与这件事我也得不到什么好处。

lines.en: : I apologize for everything. You may take as much time as you need.
lines.zh: : 我为之前的一切道歉。你想用多久就用多久。

lines.en: scene black
: In fact, let me come up with something as well. Sana’s super easy to talk to once you understand her, but she also gets bored really easily. Sensei!
lines.zh: : 其实我也得想个办法。Sana 一旦你理解了她就特别好说话，但她也很容易无聊。Sensei！

lines.en: : Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 哈？什么？

lines.en: : You’re up. Go mingle.
lines.zh: : 该你了。去应酬。

lines.en: : I thought my role was just talking to Yumi?
lines.zh: : 我以为我的任务只是跟 Yumi 谈？

lines.en: : It is! But you need to buy us some time and keep everybody occupied so no one thinks this is a lame party and leaves.
lines.zh: : 没错！但你得给我们争取点时间，让大伙儿都有事做，免得有人觉得这派对无聊就走了。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Go! Do what you do best!
lines.zh: : 去吧！做你最擅长的事！

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay23
: Uhh...
: Sup, ladies?
lines.zh: : 嗨，各位？

lines.en: : I suddenly have to go to the bathroom. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 我突然得去趟洗手间。再见。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay24
: Well, that didn’t pan out how it was supposed to.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可跟计划的不太一样。

lines.en: : She’ll be back, don’t worry. She just feels a little...out of place right now. Which is definitely my fault since I may have {i}kinda{/i} tricked her into coming, but still.
lines.zh: : 她会回来的，别担心。她只是现在有点……不自在。这肯定是我的错，因为我可能是「{i}有点{/i}」骗她来的，不过总之。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: : Y...Yeah...
: So, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……

lines.en: : Do you guys want to, like...sit down?
lines.zh: : 你们要不要……坐下来？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay25
: Can I sit on your lap? If yes, I agree. If no, I also agree. I just really like spending time with you.
lines.zh: : 我能坐你腿上吗？可以的话我同意，不可以的话我也同意。我就是很喜欢跟你待在一起。

lines.en: : Probably not right now. I’m just trying to buy time.
lines.zh: : 现在大概不行。我只是在争取点时间。

lines.en: : Time for what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 争取什么时间？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay26
: Doesn’t matter. Thank you for joining me on the floor.
lines.zh: : 不重要。谢谢你陪我坐地板。

lines.en: : The floor is the best place to do it. There’s so much surface area.
lines.zh: : 地板是做这事最好的地方。表面积大嘛。

lines.en: : That...is correct. Except we are not “doing it” right now. We’re just talking. About normal things until Ayane and Makoto are finished getting ready.
lines.zh: : 这……倒也没错。只是我们现在没在「做」。我们只是在聊天。聊些正常的事，等 Ayane 和 Makoto 准备好。

lines.en: : Getting ready for what?
lines.zh: : 准备好什么？

lines.en: : That doesn’t matter either.
lines.zh: : 那个也不重要。

lines.en: : If we’re having an orgy, we really should wait for Yumi to get back. She plays hard-to-get, sure. But I can tell she’s just as sexually frustrated as the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 如果我们要开乱交派对，真该等 Yumi 回来。她确实爱玩欲擒故纵。但我看得出来，她跟我们其他人一样欲求不满。

lines.en: : Sana, can you help me out here? I can’t fend off Noriko’s untimely hormones in a way that would benefit the current situation very much.
lines.zh: : Sana，你能帮帮我吗？我挡不住 Noriko 不合时宜的荷尔蒙，这样下去对当前的局面没好处。

lines.en: : If we’re having an orgy, I want to go first.
lines.zh: : 如果我们要开乱交派对，我要第一个来。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay27
: Damn, Sana! Can’t you at least make an exception for a girl that’s been waiting to get all up in his business for over half her life?!
lines.zh: : 靠，Sana！你就不能给个例外吗？我可是等了大半辈子，就等着能跟他亲密接触！

lines.en: : No. He’s acting strangely and only I can fix him.
lines.zh: : 不行。他现在很不对劲，而只有我能治好他。

lines.en: : I am?
lines.zh: : 我不对劲？

lines.en: : Yes. And only I can fix you.
lines.zh: : 对。而且只有我能治好你。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay28
: Come to think of it, this {i}does{/i} feel pretty weird. It’s not really like you to call for slumber parties with {i}select{/i} girls. Even if Ayane is...technically the one who called for it?
lines.zh: : 这么一想，{i}确实{/i}挺奇怪的。你特意叫上「{i}特定{/i}」的几个女孩开睡衣派对，这可不像你。就算严格来说发话的是 Ayane？

lines.en: : But you’re clearly in on whatever’s going on here, so...would you mind just explaining it to us instead of stalling for time?
lines.zh: : 但你显然也参与了眼下这件事，所以……你能不能直接跟我们解释清楚，别再拖时间了？

lines.en: : Yeah...would you mind doing that, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你能那么做吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I mean...sure. But at the very least, can we also point out that Sana is being weird right now too?
lines.zh: : 我是说……当然。但至少，我们是不是也该指出 Sana 现在也很奇怪？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay29
: I’d have agreed up until recently. Now, I have no idea who she even is anymore.
lines.zh: : 前阵子我还会同意。现在，我根本不知道她到底是谁了。

lines.en: : Why don’t you stay here and talk to me while Ayane goes and talks to Yumi? I like that plan more than the one you guys came up with.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不留下来跟我谈，让 Ayane 去跟 Yumi 谈？比起你们想出来的那个方案，我更喜欢这个。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay30
: Huh?
: You...heard that?
lines.zh: : 你……听见了？

lines.en: : It’s a small room.
lines.zh: : 房间很小。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay31
: Heard what? What’s going on with you and Yumi?
lines.zh: : 听见什么？你和 Yumi 之间怎么回事？

lines.en: : How {i}much{/i} did you hear?
lines.zh: : 你听到了{i}多少{/i}？

lines.en: : Enough for me to feel very confused.
lines.zh: : 足够让我感到非常困惑。

lines.en: : It would be nice if someone smart and experienced in teaching would tell me more about it.
lines.zh: : 如果有位聪明又富有教学经验的能人能多告诉我一些，那就太好了。

lines.en: : Oniichan, translation?
lines.zh: : Oniichan，翻译一下？

lines.en: : The translation is that Sana might be in for a bit of a wild ride tonight.
lines.zh: : 翻译过来就是——Sana 今晚可能会经历一场相当狂野的旅程。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay32
: Fine, she can go first! But if I’m any later than {i}third,{/i} I’m going to be very upset!
lines.zh: : 行，她可以第一个来！但要是我的顺序比{i}第三{/i}还靠后，我会非常不高兴！

lines.en: : I mean with Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我是说跟 Ayane 谈。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay33
: Ooh, nice. I want to watch.
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。我想看。

lines.en: : Wait, what? Ayane? You’re still-
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？Ayane？你还在——

lines.en: : {i}We{/i} can talk later if you want. Ayane’s the one you want right now. And she’s the one you’re going to get since neither of them will be able to break through to Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你想的话{i}我们{/i}可以之后再谈。现在你需要的是 Ayane。而你也只能找她，因为她们俩谁都攻不破 Yumi。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : She’ll be way better at talking about this than I am anyway. And if you’re already starting to catch on, I’m sure things will go plenty smoothly.
lines.zh: : 反正她聊这些比我强得多。而且你要是已经开始明白了，我相信一切都会很顺利。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay34
: Uhh...sorry to interrupt, but I’m starting to feel a little out of the loop here.
lines.zh: : 呃……抱歉打断一下，我好像有点跟不上你们在说什么了。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s exactly why we’re having this thing.
lines.zh: : 对。这正是我们办这场派对的原因。

lines.en: : This...sounds kind of serious all of a sudden. Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 这……突然听起来挺严肃的。一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...everything’s fine. And everything will probably stay “fine” forever because that’s how this world works.
lines.zh: : 嗯……一切都好。而且大概会永远「好」下去，因为这个世界就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : We’ll live through this same exact school year over and over and-
lines.zh: : 我们会一遍又一遍地度过完全相同的一个学年，然后——

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure{/i} everything’s fine? Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}一切都好吗？因为看起来真的不好。

lines.en: : And there’s no way it’ll ever come to an end because the world itself won’t {i}let{/i} it come to an end-
lines.zh: : 而且它永远不可能结束，因为这个世界本身不会{i}让{/i}它结束——

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure{/i} everything’s fine? Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}一切都好吗？因为看起来真的不好。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay35
: We’re all part of a loop that-
lines.zh: : 我们都身处一个循环之中——

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure{/i} everything’s fine? Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}一切都好吗？因为看起来真的不好。

lines.en: : Do you see, Sana? {i}This{/i} is what we were talking about.
lines.zh: : 你看到了吗，Sana？{i}这{/i}就是我们刚才在说的。

lines.en: : Is she...broken?
lines.zh: : 她是……坏掉了吗？

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay36
: What do you mean “broken?!” I might be a little messed up, but I’m still an energetic and driven young girl who is only {i}kind of{/i} confused when it comes to-
lines.zh: : 「坏掉了」是什么意思？！我也许是有点乱，但我依然是精力充沛、积极向上的少女，只是在某些事上{i}有点{/i}困惑——

lines.en: : Time loop.
lines.zh: : 时间循环。

lines.en: : What do you mean “broken?!” I might be a little messed up, but I’m still an energetic and driven young girl who is only {i}kind of{/i} confused when it comes to love and where to go from here!
lines.zh: : 「坏掉了」是什么意思？！我也许是有点乱，但我依然是精力充沛、积极向上的少女，只是在爱情和该何去何从上{i}有点{/i}困惑而已！

lines.en: : Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : Yeah. So that’s basically what we’re dealing with.
lines.zh: : 对。所以我们面对的基本上就是这么回事。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay37
: And Ayane can-
lines.zh: : 那 Ayane 能——

lines.en: : Ayane can do everything I can. Probably more. And if luck is on our side, this is a thing we’ll be able to talk about {i}a lot{/i} in the future. So long as you don’t replace me, that is.
lines.zh: : Ayane 能做任何我能做的事。也许更多。而且如果运气好的话，这事以后我们还能聊{i}很久{/i}。只要你别把我换掉就行。

lines.en: : But how would I-
lines.zh: : 可我怎么会——

lines.en: : Talk to her. I have to go look for Yumi.
lines.zh: : 去跟她谈。我得去找 Yumi 了。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay38
: Let me come with you! Yumi and I are friends now and-
lines.zh: : 让我跟你一起去！我和 Yumi 现在是朋友了，而且——

lines.en: : You stay here and bond with Makoto. She’s not really close with anyone here and is probably feeling lonely.
lines.zh: : 你留在这儿跟 Makoto 联络感情。她跟这儿的人都不太熟，大概会觉得孤单。

lines.en: scene beachsleepyay39
: Ah...okay. Yeah. If that’s what you want, Sensei. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 啊……好吧。好。如果你想这样的话，Sensei。我能做到。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : I really...would like to talk to you later...
lines.zh: : 我真的……想之后再跟你谈谈……

lines.en: scene black
: And you will so long as the world doesn’t explode while I’m gone. Ayane, are you ready yet?
lines.zh: : 只要我不在的这段时间世界没爆炸，你就能。Ayane，你准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Yup-yup! Sana, come! Look, I have chocolate!
lines.zh: : 好嘞好嘞！Sana，过来！看，我有巧克力！

lines.en: : Guh...a targeted attack...
lines.zh: : 咕……精准打击……

lines.en: : Noriko, if you have a minute, would you-
lines.zh: : Noriko，如果你有空的话，能不能——

lines.en: : Mm!
Noriko latches onto my waist just as I attempt to leave the room.
lines.zh: 就在我试图离开房间时，Noriko 一把抱住了我的腰。

lines.en: : Ooooor I can wait...
lines.zh: : 或者……我可以等会儿……

lines.en: : Noriko? What are you doing?
lines.zh: : Noriko？你在干什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I just felt like I had to do this.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得自己非这么做不可。

lines.en: : Are you {i}sure{/i} everything’s fine?...
lines.zh: : 你{i}确定{/i}一切都好吗？……

lines.en: : Because it really doesn’t seem fine.
lines.zh: : 因为看起来真的不好。

lines.en: : It’s complicated...but yeah.
lines.zh: : 情况很复杂……不过，是的。

lines.en: : Everything is fine.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。

lines.en: Noriko reluctantly releases me, and I pat her on the head before taking a step back.
lines.zh: Noriko 不情愿地松开我，我拍了拍她的头，后退一步。

lines.en: She doesn’t say anything else, but there’s a fear in her eyes I haven’t quite seen from her before.
lines.zh: 她没再说什么，但她眼里有种我从未在她身上见过的恐惧。

lines.en: Call it intuition if you will. Maybe she really can sense that something is amiss here.
lines.zh: 你大可以称之为直觉。也许她真的感觉到了这里有什么不对劲。

lines.en: But I’ve found that more often than not, intuition turns to premonition in this city. And that if this sentimental foresight whispers to her a hidden truth of this world, it will not be hidden for long.
lines.zh: 但我发现，在这座城市里，直觉往往会变成预感。而如果这份多愁善感的先见向她低语了这个世界某个隐藏的真相，那它就不会被隐藏太久。

lines.en: Sana looks at me as well.
lines.zh: Sana 也在看着我。

lines.en: There is no fear in her eyes, but hunger.
lines.zh: 她眼里没有恐惧，而是饥饿。

lines.en: I’m confused by her appetite, though.
lines.zh: 不过我对她的胃口感到困惑。

lines.en: Most don’t ask for seconds when someone spits in their mouth.
lines.zh: 大多数人在别人往自己嘴里吐口水之后，是不会再来第二份的。
